About the Role Newton ships on a sprint cadence through a develop, stage and customer-environment pipeline, and the product surface is wide: conversations, blueprints, connectors, scheduled tasks, permissions and sharing, SSO, and AI agents whose behavior is not fully deterministic. A missed regression lands in front of a media planner or a customer's security review. We run everything through an AI-first lens, because it is the only way quality scales. If a quality task is repeatable, an agent does it and you supervise; if it takes judgment, that is where you spend your time. The gap this hire fills: evals and skill-change testing. Code changes already have CI and review, including PRs written by Claude. What has no safety net is behavior change: an edit to a skill, a prompt, a tool definition or a model version can silently change what our agents do, and nothing tests that today. You own that layer: curated eval sets, scoring and regression tracking, so any change to how an agent behaves is measured before it ships. Measure the AI: agent output varies run to run, so “correct” is a range you define with evals, rubrics and scoring, not an exact-match assertion. jobs.title: Software Engineer – Database Kernel
jobs.description_text: The Role: The Kernel team builds the storage engine and transaction machinery inside Neo4j. If you join us, you will not be building web APIs or shuffling data between services. Instead, you will be working directly on the database engine itself. Our day-to-day is low-level systems engineering. We write and maintain custom storage engines, the page cache, transaction handling (WAL, ACID guarantees), indexing, and memory management. The code we write determines how fast queries run across billions of nodes and relationships, and how safely data is written when a machine crashes. We are a pragmatic, engineering-led group split between Malmö and London. We read and discuss database papers (VLDB, SIGMOD, and others) to see what ideas are worth pulling into the product. We also run regular “Do What You Want” weeks so everyone has dedicated time to experiment with their own prototypes or tooling improvements. What you will actually be doing: Designing, profiling, and implementing core database features, including storage formats, index structures, and recovery paths. Diagnosing tricky concurrency bugs, race conditions, and lock contention. Performance engineering: profiling CPU, memory allocation, off-heap memory, and disk I/O to improve latency. Reviewing designs and PRs with a heavy focus on correctness, data integrity, and long-term maintainability. Helping decide technical direction and architectural trade-offs as our engine evolves. What we are looking for: Systems programming

jobs.description_text: The Role: We're looking for a software engineer to join the Neo4j Sharding Engineering team. We own Infinigraph and Composite , and we make them work as managed offerings on Aura, Neo4j’s cloud platform. Aura is Neo4j’s fully managed graph database as a service. Customers create, scale, and use Neo4j databases in the cloud without installing, clustering, or operating the database themselves. Aura runs on Kubernetes across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure, and handles provisioning, networking, security, upgrades, and day-to-day operations for those databases. Composite is the technology behind distributed query execution in Neo4j: one query can span multiple databases. Infinigraph is our database sharding offering for large data volumes, built on a distributed database architecture. Distributed query execution is a complex and interesting topic covering query language design, performant networking, and concurrency. Those capabilities still have to run as a cloud product, and that's where a large part of this role sits: building the Go services and Kubernetes machinery that provision, scale, and operate sharded and composite clusters on Aura, reliably, at the data volumes our customers keep growing into. As part of an energetic and fun team of engineers, you'll work at the frontier of designing and implementing new capabilities for Neo4j on Aura. This role will serve as a trusted technology partner to HR and Legal leaders, translating business priorities into an integrated application, data, and transformation roadmap. The leader will oversee a portfolio of HR and Legal systems and services, drive modernization and simplification, and ensure that technology investments improve employee experience, operational effectiveness, risk management, and business agility. The ideal candidate brings strong industry experience in HR and Legal technology, a track record of implementing and transforming enterprise systems, and the ability to influence across business and technology organizations. They are equally comfortable shaping strategy, leading complex programs, improving operational discipline, and developing high-performing teams. WHAT YOU'LL DO Proactively identify and champion innovative ideas to transform HR processes by leveraging emerging technologies and solutions, such as AI. Define and execute the HR & Legal technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap in partnership with HR, Legal, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, and Digital Transformation leaders. jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Security
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE As Director of Security Product Management for FlashArray, you will build, mentor, and direct the product teams responsible for the overarching security posture of Everpure’s flagship storage platform. You will establish long-term strategic objectives, budgeting priorities, and operational resource plans to navigate evolving global compliance and embed secure-by-design capabilities across our portfolio. Collaborating closely with executive leadership, Engineering, and the CTO office, you will transform rigorous security standards into a high-performance competitive advantage that wins the trust of global enterprise and government organizations. WHAT YOU'LL DO Strategic Leadership & Team Management : Build, coach, and direct a team of product managers, establishing functional goals, staffing priorities, and talent development frameworks to drive execution across the security portfolio. Product Vision & Portfolio Strategy : Own the multi-year security roadmap—spanning encryption, identity and access management (IAM), and zero-trust frameworks—to consistently exceed the requirements of highly regulated global industries. Compliance & Regulatory Program Delivery : Drive the strategy and execution for acquiring and maintaining critical certifications (such as FIPS, Common Criteria, and FedRAMP), expanding Everpure’s addressable market in public and private sectors. Collaborating closely with peer engineering organizations, Architecture, and Product Management, your mission is to deliver bulletproof infrastructure that impacts our global platform scale for years to come. Drive Global Platform Convergence: Direct the cross-functional engineering initiatives to unify critical shared infrastructure across flagship product lines, successfully managing complex architectural dependencies and rigorous testing disciplines. jobs.title: Director, Partner Execution Office
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE: We are seeking a senior partner leader to drive one of the most consequential company-wide initiatives underway at Everpure. We go to market through partners, and our next phase of growth will come from deepening that model by designing for partners from the start, in every function. As Director, Partner Operating Model, you will be the company's key advisor and expert on this effort: reimagining how we engage our partner ecosystem across the full go-to-market and product lifecycle, and across every organization that touches it. This is a rare mandate to shape how an entire company operates, with results that affect the long-term success of the company. The work reaches well beyond the Global Partner Organization (GPO), and you will be the one driving it. You will be the GPO leader for the program, bringing the partner lens, the partner voice and the stakeholder alignment that make the recommendations real, with wide latitude to set objectives and approaches for critical assignments. You will understand and validate how our partner processes work end to end, test findings against field and partner reality, assess partner impact and feasibility of proposed changes, and carry final recommendations into workstream charters. From there, you will own the outcome, not just the recommendations. Over a multi-year horizon, you will move from shaping the assessment to leading cross-functional execution of the multi-year roadmap. This is a thought-leadership and influence role

jobs.title: Director, Partner Experience
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE: Our partners should be able to autonomously do business with Everpure quickly and confidently. As Director, Partner Experience, you will own the strategy, processes and execution to make that happen: increasing partner self-sufficiency, removing friction from every partner touchpoint, and reducing our cost-to-serve. This work will directly impact Sales productivity, Finance and Operations workload, and partner profitability. This is a business leadership role that sits at the intersection of partners, the field and technology. You will own the business side of the partner experience, defining what partners and the field need and bridging those business requirements to our Digital Transformation team, who build and run the systems, with support from Business Systems Analysts. You will also own partner data health: the definitions, quality standards and governance that make sure partner data is captured correctly and can be trusted. You will own the overall direction, priorities and outcomes for partner autonomy, spanning partner satisfaction, tool adoption, end-to-end partner process ownership, partner data health, change management and system optimization. You will set the strategy and success measures, and make sure partner and field feedback turns into prioritized enhancements that land so the overall partner experience measurably improves. jobs.title: Director, People Partners
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE HR at Everpure is in the middle of an exciting transformation! We’re building a connected, high-impact HR organization to support our rapidly growing global workforce. Positioned between HR Operations and HR Business Partners, the People Partner Specialist team delivers scalable, specialized expertise to leaders and managers across our global workforce. As Director, People Partner Specialist, you will architect this function from the ground up, lead a high-performing team, and establish a best-in-class support model globally. This is a unique opportunity to build, lead, and optimize a critical HR function during a period of strategic modernization. If you love the rare combination of designing the system and running the system, this is the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build and lead the Partner Specialist team, owning its charter, budget, staffing plans, and performance standards while shaping a coverage model that delivers one consistent, high-quality experience across every region. Design the global tiering framework and routing logic for a function with no precedent, co-creating boundaries with HR Operations and HRBP leaders and owning the final decisions with executive sign-off. Lead the pilot, measurement, and scale-up of the service model in partnership with HR Operations and HRBP leaders, using resolution time, manager satisfaction, and HRBP capacity as the markers of success.
